Tosafot on Bava Batra 72b:2:1.hebrew: לדבריהם דרבנן - ולא מצי למימר דסברא דנפשיה קאמר, דהא לדידיה אפילו הקדיש אילן לא הקדיש קרקע, כדקתני בברייתא. כ"ש דלא הקדיש עם השדה קרקע הצריך לאילן, כדפרישית לעיל:
Tosafot on Bava Batra 72b:2:1.english: According to the words of the Rabbis - And [the Gemara] cannot say that he is stating his own opinion, for according to him, even if one consecrated a tree, he did not consecrate the ground, as is taught in the baraita. All the more so, when one consecrated the field, he did not consecrate along with it the ground that the tree needs, as I explained above:

Tosafot on Bava Batra 72b:7:1.hebrew: הכי גרסינן: ואילו רבי יהודה ור"ש, הקדיש ואח"כ מת אביו — כשדה אחוזה דמיא - ולא גרסינן "היכא דמת אביו ואח"כ הקדישה — לא צריך קרא", דשפיר צריך קרא לכך. אלא ר' יהודה ור"ש דידעי מסברא דהוא הדין הקדישה ואח"כ מת אביו, משום דאזלי בתר פדיון. אלא בהשולח (גיטין דף מח.) גרסינן ליה, והסופרים טעו וכתבו גם כאן:
Tosafot on Bava Batra 72b:7:1.english: This is how we read: "But according to Rabbi Yehuda and Rabbi Shimon, [if] he consecrated [the field] and afterward his father died — it is considered like a field of inheritance" - And we do not read, "Where his father died and afterward he consecrated it — no verse is needed," for a verse is certainly needed for this. Rather, Rabbi Yehuda and Rabbi Shimon know through logic that the same applies where he consecrated it and afterward his father died, because they follow [the time of] redemption. But in [the chapter] Hashole'ach (Gittin 48a) we do read it [that way], and the scribes erred and wrote it here as well.

Tosafot on Bava Batra 72b:9:1.hebrew: קרא אשכחו ודרוש - ה"נ הוה מצי למדחי: דבהא פליגי רבי יהודה ור"ש. סברי: קנין פירות לאו כקנין הגוף דמי, ולא איצטריך קרא למת אביו ואחר כך הקדישה, דהא לגמרי הוה שדה אחוזה — דהא בחיי האב לא היה לו כי אם פירות, ולא איצטריך קרא אלא להקדישה ואח"כ מת אביו, ולא משום דאזלי בתר פדיון. ורבי מאיר סבר: כקנין הגוף דמי, ואיצטריך קרא למת אביו ואחר כך הקדישה, שלא ירש כלום, דמעיקרא נמי היתה שלו. והכי הוה בעי לאוקמי פלוגתא בסוף השולח (שם):
Tosafot on Bava Batra 72b:9:1.english: "They found a verse and expounded it" - So too, [the Gemara] could have rejected [the question], [by saying] that Rabbi Yehudah and Rabbi Shimon disagree about this. They hold that acquiring the produce is not like acquiring the body [of the land], and a verse was not needed for [a case where] his father died and afterward he consecrated it, since [in that case] it was entirely an ancestral field — for during his father's lifetime he had only the produce, and the verse was needed only for [a case where] he consecrated it and afterward his father died, and not because they follow the redemption. But Rabbi Meir holds that [acquiring the produce] is like acquiring the body, and a verse was needed for [a case where] his father died and afterward he consecrated it, [to teach] that he did not inherit anything, since originally too it was his. And this is how [the Gemara] wanted to establish the disagreement at the end of [the chapter] HaShole'ach (there).
